name: S1ClientBatcher

test_list.description: A burst exercises the eight-item maximum and routes each result to its correct caller.
Cancelling one caller while the worker RPC is pending does not block the remaining callers.
Repeated requests are not served from a cache when authenticated health has no loaded-model identity.
A response spanning a worker identity change is not cached under the later generation.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: One validated SDK schema and input, with a caller-specific response channel and deadline.

inputs.name: worker_contract
inputs.description: Existing repeated-items RPC with a worker maximum of eight items.

output_description: A single bounded queue coalesces concurrent calls for at most three milliseconds, flushes at eight calls, enforces caller deadlines and routes each result to its own waiter. Cache entries require a fresh authenticated loaded-model digest and generation.
